mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 35 degrees, an overnight low of 30, and no rain in the forecast under a full moon.

In city news, please note that all city buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27. Refuse and recycling pickup normally scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed as well.
We have a busy few days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run today, music at Lake Lou-ee on November 23, and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a report regarding notable calls between November 1 and 15, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash where one driver was arrested for O W I with a child passenger in the vehicle.
Enjoy the delicious OREO Cookie Overload at Culver's tonight. They are currently open and will be serving until their closing time at 10 PM.
